title: Empirical limits on what a model can hide: probing whether a 'secret' computation leaves detectable activation traces

original_idea.body:
# Detectable Traces of Secret Computation

Induce a hidden rule; train linear probes on activations, vary suppression level, measure detectability.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: detectability limits of hidden cognition bear directly on monitoring and CoT-unfaithful model organisms.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Few-shot/fine-tune hidden rule plus linear probes; clear methodology.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected steered priority (hidden cognition / model organisms), no lab infra, strong external value.

novelty.reasoning: ELK probing of hidden behavior is studied; the detectability-vs-verbalization-suppression angle may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Hidden-behavior probing exists; the suppression-detectability angle may be open.
